title_as_printed: EQUILIBRIUM WATER CONTENT OF METHANE-HYDROGEN SULFIDE VAPOR AT 160 F
property_description: water content of the CH4-H2S vapour phase in ppm (basis - mole, mass or volume - not stated in the paper); candidate for y_h2o if the builder treats ppm as mole ppm. Fig. 4 of the paper plots the same data as mole fraction of water, which suggests mole basis but the table/text never say so.
pressure_note: Column 'Pressure psia'; text: 'water content of pure methane at pressures up to 1,495 psia'; whether total cell pressure is not stated explicitly (mixture vapour in equilibrium with water, cell pressure set by pumping confining fluid).

gas_composition.unit: percent (Fig. 4 caption: 'mole percent of hydrogen sulphide in vapour phase'; table says only %)
gas_composition.note: balance of the dry gas is methane

uncertainty.what: max and min deviation of individual samples from the average, printed as '- a; + b' strings

composition.other_species: H2S content of vapor (16-29 %) given in column; remainder methane; liquid phase distilled water (no salt)

extra_unmapped: Avg. Peak Height Chart Units (raw chromatograph signal)
conversion_needs: ppm basis must be established (mole assumed only by Fig. 4 context)
notes: Rows are in printed order; the composition (H2S content) differs for every row because the vapour composition could not be kept constant over a range of pressures per cell charge. volume_basis not applicable.
